items.name: from_env
items.source:
pub fn from_env() -> Result<SocketSetup, String> {
    resolve(
        crate::operation_context::var("LISTEN_UNIX_SOCKET")
            .ok()
            .as_deref(),
        crate::operation_context::var("LISTEN_UNIX_SOCKET_MODE")
            .ok()
            .as_deref(),
        crate::operation_context::var("LISTEN_UNIX_SOCKET_GROUP")
            .ok()
            .as_deref(),
    )
}
